programs.title: Jack Hanna's Passport
programs.desc: Catching caiman reptiles on the banks of the Amazon River; tracking African wildlife in Gabon; unusual amphibians in Panama; ziplining in the jungle; rafting on the Zambezi River.

programs.title: Home for Good
programs.desc: Art and the team extend their hand to help firefighter and paramedic, Ronnie Estep, a 27-year-old father whose old home burned to the ground; in just seven days, the team tackles a complete makeover of the kitchen but goes above and beyond by renovating the living room, office space, dining room, plus a special surprise in store for this deserving family.

programs.title: Hearts of Heroes
programs.desc: The U.S. Coast Guard attempts a high-risk landing to evacuate an injured passenger; when a pilot sacrifices everything to steer a crashing plane away from a crowded shoreline, rescuers race against time to pull him from the water.
